name: Ramgopal Polytex Limited
about: Ramgopal Polytex Limited engages in wholesale trading of commodities in India. It offers plastic products, including HDPE, PP, LLDP, and PBC; and textile raw materials comprising POY, PFY, spandex, yarn, viscose, and polyester spurn and rayon filament yarn. The company provides steel and metal products, including iron ore, pig iron, ferroy alloys, deformed bars, wire rods, round bars, HR and CR coils, galvanized coils, seamless and stainless-steel pipes, and steel billets. In addition, it is involved in the trading of polymer and yarns. Ramgopal Polytex Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.
